# Chapter 5: Heather and Bobby

The babies came, a boy and a girl, and as it happened the world changed.

Nancy gave birth to their daughter first — a quiet infant, watchful in ways that would later reveal themselves as the careful attention of someone taking notes on the human condition. They named her Heather, after the purple blooms Bob had seen on a business trip to England, wildflowers that carpeted hillsides in colors too stubborn to be called merely pink.
